title: Script executed in the host context (javascript)
description: javascript code compiles or runs a script in the current context (vm.runInThisContext). The sandbox that protects a fresh context is gone, so the script reaches the process globals, its environment and its loaded modules. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the input is trusted.
remediation: Run untrusted scripts in an isolated context or a separate process with no host objects, or replace the mechanism with vm.runInNewContext with an empty sandbox.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call even when the script text is a constant shipped with the program.
